chunks: Abu 'Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Mansur, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who goes out on a journey and his wife is with him, then she dies: may he perform ghusl for her? He said: Yes. And likewise his mother, his sister, and the like of these; he places a cloth over her 'awrah.

key_terms.خِرْقَةً: a piece of cloth used as covering
key_terms.عَوْرَتِهَا: her private parts that must be covered
key_terms.يُغَسِّلُهَا: he performs the ritual washing of her body

ai.seo_question: Can a man perform ghusl for his deceased wife or female relative during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning washing a deceased female relative when necessary during travel. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام permits a man to wash his wife, and also mentions close female relatives such as his mother and sister, provided that a cloth is placed over the 'awrah.
